Name: Shop Life - Open a Drink Shop on Your Farm
Author: XI221
Description:
[size=5][b]Shop Life[/b][/size]
[b]Now in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese[/b] (plus Chinese). This is a test version (0.9.1) - feedback is very welcome, see the questions at the bottom. The translations are new, so if a line sounds wrong, please tell me in the comments.

[size=4][b]Opening your shop[/b][/size]
From spring 15 of year 1, Mayor Lewis writes about opening a shop. Talk to him to get a license (5,000g, then 1,000g business tax at the start of each season) and name your shop. Robin's build menu then has the drink shop. The morning after it's built, Gus sends a letter with some tips from an old hand.

[size=4][b]Running the counter[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Open 10:00-18:00 by default. Flip the sign by the door to close for a few days, or change your hours.[/*]
[*]Villagers come on their own when they're free, order based on what they like (no one orders something they hate), and an order ticket with a patience bar appears at the top of the screen.[/*]
[*]Stock the ingredient cabinet (milk, tea leaves, sugar...), face the counter to make a drink, then hand it to the customer or click their table. Their drink sits on the table while they drink it.[/*]
[*]27 drinks: year-round ones, seasonal specials, 4 you discover by experimenting in the kitchen, and 2 limited specials. Out-of-season drinks can still be ordered if you have the ingredients - at a higher price.[/*]
[*]Every evening the cash register shows a daily report: income, costs, who came, reviews, and tomorrow's weather.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Growing the business[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Staff[/b]: once a villager likes you (4 hearts), ask if they want to work for you. 16 villagers can be hired, each with their own wage expectations. Make one the chef and another the waiter; staff get better the more they work.[/*]
[*][b]Expansion[/b]: as total sales grow, Robin can build a kitchen (more drinks, a chalkboard for the daily special), a storage room (a row of fridges, staff fetch ingredients themselves) and a private booth (friends come in groups and tip).[/*]
[*][b]Stars[/b]: your shop goes from 1 to 5 stars based on sales and reviews. Regulars appear and some villagers send thank-you letters.[/*]
[*][b]Supply deals[/b]: Marnie, Caroline, Pierre, Willy, Gus and Joja can deliver ingredients every week. Negotiate the price - say what they care about and they go lower, guess wrong and they're less happy with you. Small talk sometimes gives you a hint. Long-term partners give better prices.[/*]
[*]Put up an ad on the town bulletin board (300g) to bring in more customers.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Farmhands can make and serve drinks, check the daily report and negotiate supply deals; the host's shop and money are used. Tested in split-screen; not yet tested with 3-4 players online - please report any problems.

[size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Before removing the mod, type [b]shop_uninstall[/b] in the SMAPI console to see what it will do, then [b]shop_uninstall confirm[/b]. Vanilla items in your shop and inventory go into a chest in your farmhouse, this mod's items are sold for their value, and the shop building is removed. If you skip this, your save still loads, but anything left in the shop and this mod's drinks in your inventory are lost.

[size=4][b]Feedback wanted[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Did you understand how to start (license, building, your first drink) without looking anything up?[/*]
[*]How long did it take to reach 2 stars and to build the kitchen? Too fast, too slow?[/*]
[*]Were supply deals worth it compared to buying ingredients yourself?[/*]
[*]Did any customer or staff member get stuck, walk somewhere strange, or never show up?[/*]
[*]Which other mods are you using, and did anything conflict?[/*]
[*]Did any translated text read badly, or not fit in its box?[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.0+. Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu (business tax, grace days for unpaid tax, opening and closing time). Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (BR), Chinese.

Fan-made mod; Stardew Valley characters and art belong to ConcernedApe.

[size=4][b]中文[/b][/size]
开店人生：在农场上开一家饮品店。第一年春 15 日起刘易斯来信，找他办执照、起店名，再找罗宾盖店。村民有空会自己上门，按口味点单；你备料、在柜台做饮品、端给客人。攒够营业额请罗宾扩建后厨、仓库、包间，雇镇上的朋友当大厨和服务生，跟玛妮、卡洛琳他们谈供货。支持中文、英语、西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语，0.9 测试版，欢迎反馈。卸载前在 SMAPI 控制台输入 shop_uninstall confirm。
